asr.full_text: Avalanche is like Frankenstein's monster, stitched together with bits of ethereum, Nakamoto consensus, and a sprinkle of MIT-level brilliance, but is it alive and thriving, or just lying dormant in the bear market? By the end of this video, we're putting Avalanche to the test with a final score out of 100. Whether you're an AVAX staker, or simply exploring the smart-contract world, you'll want to hear our verdict, team and development. Avalanche was officially launched in September, 2020 by Aval.abs, a company founded by Dr. Emin Gunn-Cyrer, a computer science professor at Cornell University and longtime blockchain researcher. He's also the founder of Aval.abs, the company behind the development of Avalanche. The team is highly technical and includes blockchain veterans, academics, and entrepreneurs. they've consistently delivered updates, and their roadmap is ambitious with subnets, enterprise partnerships and DeFi growth. Score 9 out of 10, use-case, and Utility. Avalanche is designed to be a high-performance smart contract platform, with sub-second finality and low fees. It targets DeFi, NFTs, institutional use, and even gaming with custom blockchains called subnets. This ability to launch tailored blockchains gives Avalanche real-world utility beyond just being an Ethereum competitor. 8 out of 10, Tokenomics AVAX has a hard- capped supply of 720 million tokens meaning no unlimited inflation will dilute its value over time adding to its scarcity avalanche implements a fee burning mechanism where transaction fees and network charges are permanently destroyed making avatar slightly deflationary as network usage grows however the initial token distribution raises some concerns early investors the avalanche foundation and the a few years ago. That is right, it was only around March 2-3, 2021. Of course, they're growing higher and higher. I would say we are in a moment where we are in a time of recovery. The first time they broke into our store, we were only 2-3 days before we entered the market. In another month when they opened up, I didn't have no idea. In fact, I wanted to get in touch with each and every one of their followers. Bull Run, fueled by DeFi incentives and its Ethereum killer narrative. But underneath the buzz, it has real tech, fast finality, innovative consensus, and scalable architecture. That said, activity has cooled during the bear market, and some hype-driven projects have left. Still, it retains strong developer interest. Score, 8 out of 10. Market Liquidity and Volatility AVAX is listed on all major exchanges, including Binance value is 10,500 million. Your average cryptocurrency on Bitcoin will be more than you think. After every trade, your total on bitcoin will rise by more, more than 40%, if you're holding a cryptocurrency. AVAX is on the market for developer interest. Score, eight out of 10, market liquidity and volatility. AVAX is listed on all major exchanges, including Binance, Coinbase, Kraken and more. It has decent liquidity, making it easy to trade. 6 out of 10 Security and Decentralization Avalanche uses its own consensus mechanism, AVALANCHE Consensus, which allows 1,000's of validators with minimal hardware. While it is not as decentralized as Bitcoin, it is significantly more distributed than many layer 1s. The network has never suffered a critical exploit. 8, out of 10 Network Activity and Adoption Daily transaction counts, and active wallet addresses indicate steady if not explosive usage. Avalanche has seen traction with GameFi projects. DeFi protocols like Trader Joe, and institutions testing sub nets. But compared to Ethereum, or even Solana network usage is still relatively modest. Score, six out of ten. Scalability and technology. Scalability is the Avalanche's strong suit. Its three-chain architecture — X-Chain for assets, C-Chain for smart contracts, and P-Chain for staking and governance — is designed to scale without congestion. Subnets allow apps to run their own custom blockchains, a major differentiator. However, interoperability with other chains can still improve. Score 8 out of 10. Regulatory Risks Avalanche isn't immune to regulatory risks. The blockchain itself hasn't been hacked, but some apps built on Avalanche have been — that's made regulators pay more attention. On top of that, new laws like MyCar and Europe, and delays from the SEC and the US, create more attention. On top of that, new laws like My CAR in Europe and delays from the SEC in the US create more uncertainty. Even Avalanche's privacy tools could raise questions from governments because they make it harder to trace who's sending or receiving money, which can be a problem for anti-money laundering rules. The team is working to follow the rules, but things are still a bit unclear. Four out of ten. Self-custody Avax supports self-custody through major hardware wallets like trezor, which can be used with metamask as a bridge Metamask connects to the avalanche network while trezor keeps your private keys safely offline Just like with any crypto self-custody is key to real security when you hold your own keys in a secure wallet you're the only one who can access your funds. No middle-men, and no risks from centralized platforms. At Crypto-Vagabonds Academy, we'll teach you exactly how to protect your assets with the right tools and cold storage strategies. If you're ready to stop relying on exchanges and take full control of your wealth, this is where it starts. Join us and become the master of your own crypto. 6 out of 10 Final Thought, Avalanche offers a powerful blockchain with unique features like subnets, fast finality, and a solid development team, but it still faces stiff competition, regulatory uncertainties, and questions about long-term adoption. Final Score 71 out of 100 What Do You Think? regulatory uncertainties and questions about long-term adoption final score 71 out of 100 what do you think is avalanche a long-term ethereum rival or just another flashy altcoin let us know in the comments and if there's another project you'd like us to analyze drop it below if you found this breakdown useful make sure to like this video and subscribe to the channel your support helps us keep delivering straight to the point content without hype or fluff See you in the next one and as always stay curious and stay hodling
